description: delay(), delayMicroseconds() and millis()/micros() against the simulated time.
basis: Timer 0 core: millis() advances 1 per 1.024 ms overflow plus a fractional correction of 3/125 per overflow (wiring.c), so an interval of N ms measures N-1..N+1; micros() has 4 us resolution and delayMicroseconds(1000) takes 1000 us plus about 4 us of call overhead

tolerances.reason: millis() granularity: a 100 ms interval spans 97 or 98 overflows plus 2 or 3 fractional increments
micros() has 4 us resolution; call overhead of micros() and delayMicroseconds()
